clauses.text: Keep this file current in the same PR.
A merge never cuts a tag. `/release` does.
Branch from `main` and open a PR into `main`.
Delete merged feature branches locally and remotely.

clauses.rationale: Saved preferences cannot be described as retraining.

clauses.text: Never claim a result you did not observe
clauses.rationale: Honesty about what was verified is the whole house contract. A skill that reports success it did not witness is worse than one that reports nothing.
Claude and Codex need real image capabilities, not assumed APIs.

clauses.text: never ask about anything in it
clauses.rationale: Two questions maximum is only achievable because detection already answered the rest. Asking about a detectable signal is the UX failure that makes a skill feel like a form.

clauses.text: Silence creates no approval and no style update
clauses.rationale: No autonomous mutation of brand from lack of feedback.

clauses.text: Every generation uses the selected versioned brand profile; only explicit durable feedback changes that profile, and a one-off image request never silently rewrites the brand.
